title: Mosaic: Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Mosaic：多会话智能体强化学习

paragraphs.en: Most existing agentic reinforcement learning methods assume single-session trajectories, where interaction proceeds within one continuously accumulated context. However, agentic techniques such as context compaction and subagent forking may produce trajectories spanning multiple sessions, creating a mismatch between the single-session training assumption and inference-time execution. Therefore, we introduce Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning , a more general setting that supports an arbitrary number of sessions within a trajectory. Under this setting, a widely adopted method is to broadcast trajectory-level advantages to all sessions, but this does not distinguish contributions from various sessions or guide session allocation within trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Mosaic , a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. At the trajectory level, it incorporates session-usage signals into advantage estimation. At the session level, it shapes each session’s advantage according to the estimated marginal contribution. Experiments on BrowseComp with Qwen3.5-4B show that Mosaic outperforms broadcasting in both context compaction and subagent forking scenarios while using fewer sessions on average. Further analyses show that our method achieves improvements in session utility and allocation, which we suggested is a promising target for future advances in multi-session agentic RL.

paragraphs.en: Agentic Reinforcement Learning ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 , Agentic RL;) trains Large Language Model (LLM) agents ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) for multi-turn reasoning, tool use, and interaction with external environments via online rollouts and reward feedback, yielding broad performance gains. More recently, LLM agents have incorporated advanced inference techniques, such as context management ( Mei et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) and harness engineering ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , enabling agentic workflows to tackle increasingly complex and long-horizon tasks. However, most agentic RL methods assume a single-session setting, where each rollout unfolds as a coherent multi-turn trajectory within a continuously accumulated context and yields a single training segment ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ) .

paragraphs.en: We argue that the single-session setting is not sufficiently general for optimizing LLM agents. For example, context compaction compresses the execution history to free up context space while rewriting the prefix that conditions subsequent actions ( Nguyen et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) , thereby initiating a new session. Similarly, subagent forking delegates global goal to subagents which creates branch sessions ( Xu et al., 2026d ; Team et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2025 ) . Those resulting trajectories no longer satisfy the single-session assumption, creating a mismatch between training and inference that compromises consistency and limits optimization potential.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，单次会话设置对于优化大型语言模型智能体而言并不足够通用。 例如，上下文压缩会压缩执行历史以释放上下文空间，同时重写用于约束后续动作的前缀（Nguyen 等，2025；Wu 等，2025；Lu 等，2025），从而开启一个新的会话。 类似地，子智能体分叉会将全局目标委托给子智能体，从而创建分支会话（Xu 等，2026d；Team 等，2026；Song 等，2025）。 由此产生的轨迹不再满足单次会话假设，导致训练与推理之间出现不匹配，进而损害一致性并限制优化潜力。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we introduce a new setting termed Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning , which supports an arbitrary count of sessions and enables agents with diverse inference mechanisms to be optimized within a unified algorithm. A straightforward way to handle multi-session rollouts is through broadcasting , whereby a trajectory-level outcome reward or advantage is replicated to every token across all sessions ( Accio-Lab, 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026a ) . However, we argue that this method provides only coarse supervision and offers no explicit control over optimization across sessions, resulting in poorly targeted learning signals as trajectories span more sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为“多会话智能体强化学习”的新设定，该设定支持任意数量的会话，并使得具有不同推理机制的智能体能够在统一的算法框架内得到优化。 处理多会话展开的一个直接方法是通过广播机制，即将轨迹层面的结果奖励或优势复制到所有会话中的每一个词元（Accio-Lab, 2026；Xu et al., 2026a）。 然而，我们认为这种方法仅提供粗略的监督，无法对跨会话的优化过程进行明确控制，导致学习信号随着轨迹所跨越的会话数量增加而变得缺乏针对性。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose Mosaic , a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. First, session-aware trajectory-level advantage estimation calibrates outcome-based advantages using within-group rankings of session counts conditioned on task outcomes, encouraging successful trajectories to solve tasks efficiently while allowing unsuccessful trajectories sufficient exploration. Its bounded modulation preserves outcome-induced ordering while incorporating session-usage guidance, thereby widening relative advantage margins for homogeneous-reward groups. Second, session-level advantage shaping calculates each session’s marginal outcome gain as an immediate reward, applies group-relative normalization separately by session type, and combines the resulting shaping signal with the trajectory-level advantage. Overall, the former provides a long-term, outcome-oriented global signal, while the latter captures short-term local marginal effects. They together form a hierarchical optimization target for multi-session agentic RL.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 Mosaic——一种无需评论者的分层优化多会话智能体强化学习方法。 首先，会话感知的轨迹级优势估计通过基于任务结果的会话次数组内排名来校准结果导向的优势，从而鼓励成功轨迹高效完成任务，同时允许不成功轨迹进行充分的探索。 其有界调制在保留结果诱导排序的同时融入了会话使用指导，从而扩大了同质奖励组的相对优势差距。 其次，会话级优势塑造将每个会话的边际结果收益计算为即时奖励，按会话类型分别应用组内相对归一化，并将由此产生的塑造信号与轨迹级优势相结合。 总体而言，前者提供长期、以结果为导向的全局信号，而后者则捕捉短期局部边际效应。 二者共同构成了多会话智能体强化学习的分层优化目标。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate our method, we conduct experiments on BrowseComp ( Wei et al., 2025 ) and select Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as the base model. Our Mosaic outperforms multiple single-session and multi-session agentic RL baselines under both context compaction and subagent forking scenarios. Moreover, Mosaic achieves up to a 10.1% relative improvement in accuracy over the broadcasting baseline while using fewer sessions per trajectory on average ( 3.17 → 2.35 3.17\rightarrow 2.35 ). Ablation studies further demonstrate that session-aware trajectory-level advantage estimation and session-level advantage shaping each contribute to the final performance gains. Our analyses also reveal several key insights: (1) shaping trajectory-level advantages with session counts increases within-group advantage variance and improves sample efficiency; (2) different session types exhibit distinct distributions of session-level marginal gains, which our type-conditioned normalization helps stabilize; (3) effective multi-session optimization improves session utility and allocation, a pattern that Mosaic strengthens and that might offer a potential direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估我们的方法，我们在 BrowseComp（Wei 等人，2025）上进行了实验，并选择 Qwen3.5-4B（Qwen 团队，2026）作为基础模型。 在上下文压缩和子智能体分叉两种场景下，我们的 Mosaic 方法在性能上优于多种单会话和多会话的智能体强化学习基线方法。 此外，与广播基线方法相比，Mosaic 的准确率相对提升了高达 10.1%，同时每条轨迹平均使用的会话数更少（3.17 → 2.35）。 消融研究进一步表明，会话感知的轨迹级优势估计和会话级优势塑造各自对最终性能的提升做出了贡献。 我们的分析还揭示了几项关键见解：(1) 使用会话次数来塑造轨迹级优势会增加组内优势方差并提高样本效率；(2) 不同类型的会话表现出不同的会话级边际收益分布，而我们的类型条件归一化方法有助于稳定这种分布；(3) 有效的多会话优化能够提升会话效用和分配效率，Mosaic 强化了这一模式，这或许为未来研究提供了一个潜在方向。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 (c)(d) presents the ablation results. Relative to Broadcasting, both levels of components in Mosaic , namely trajectory-level session-aware advantage estimation and session-level advantage shaping, contribute to the enhanced final performance. Combining the two components yields a clear additional gain in the compact scenario, but only a modest gain in the subagent scenario. One possible explanation lies in their session structures: compact trajectories are linear, whereas subagent trajectories have a nonlinear structure that more closely resembles a directed acyclic graph. In the latter case, a session may influence multiple succeeding sessions. Its immediate reward, estimated from marginal gain, may thus differ from its actual contribution to the final outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 (c)(d) 展示了消融实验结果。 与 Broadcasting 相比，Mosaic 中的两个组件层级，即轨迹级会话感知优势估计和会话级优势塑造，都有助于提升最终性能。 在紧凑场景中，结合这两个组件能带来明显的额外增益，但在子智能体场景中仅带来有限的增益。 一种可能的解释在于它们的会话结构：紧凑轨迹是线性的，而子智能体轨迹具有非线性结构，更接近有向无环图。 在后一种情况下，一个会话可能会影响多个后续会话。 因此，通过边际增益估计出的即时奖励可能与它对最终结果的实际贡献存在差异。

paragraphs.en: RQ3 asks how the design of Mosaic contributes to the training process .
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题3探讨了 Mosaic 的设计如何促进训练过程。

paragraphs.en: First, we examine whether session-aware trajectory-level advantage estimation produces the intended ordering. As shown in Figure 5 , within mixed-outcome groups, advantages approximately decrease with session count for successful trajectories and increase for unsuccessful ones, while successful trajectories retain higher advantages. In homogeneous-outcome groups, the fallback mechanism introduces session-dependent variation, providing differentiated learning signals despite identical outcome rewards. These patterns illustrate how Mosaic leverages session signals to increase the within-group variance of relative advantages, thus improving sample efficiency during training.

paragraphs.en: Multi-session optimization introduces an additional degree of freedom in how computation is distributed across sessions. However, the session count used by Mosaic serves only as a proxy signal and is not inherently tied to exploration intensity or execution cost. Moreover, at inference time, the model has no access to hindsight: it does not know how many sessions a trajectory will ultimately contain or whether the trajectory will succeed. Therefore, RQ4 moves beyond method-specific analysis and asks a broader question: when multi-session optimization improves task performance, what session-level behavioral patterns emerge?

paragraphs.en: Accordingly, we examine session-level behavior along three dimensions: quantity , or whether the count of sessions increases or decreases; quality , or whether performance improvement is accompanied by more useful sessions; and allocation , or whether a limited session budget becomes increasingly concentrated on execution stages with high marginal utility. As shown in Table 2 , for Broadcasting, which does not directly optimize any specific session-aware pattern, all three metrics increase. Under Mosaic , the number of sessions does not increase further, while both session quality and allocation improve. These findings indicate that performance gains via multi-session optimization are associated with improved session utility rather than a monotonic rise in session count. Moreover, despite using explicit session-aware optimization, Mosaic does not induce a fundamentally altered behavioral mechanism. Instead, it strengthens the session-allocation patterns that already emerge from naïve multi-session optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们从三个维度考察会话级行为：数量，即会话次数是增加还是减少；质量，即性能提升是否伴随着更多有用的会话；以及分配，即有限的会话预算是否越来越集中在具有较高边际效用的执行阶段。 如表 2 所示，对于 Broadcasting（它并未直接优化任何特定的会话感知模式），三项指标均有所提升。 在 Mosaic 模式下，会话次数未进一步增加，但会话质量和分配均得到改善。 这些发现表明，通过多会话优化获得的性能提升与会话效用的提高相关，而非会话次数的单调增长。 此外，尽管 Mosaic 采用了显式的会话感知优化，但它并未引发行为机制的根本性改变。 相反，它强化了原本就出现在朴素多会话优化中的会话分配模式。

paragraphs.en: We argue that effective multi-session optimization is accompanied by improvements in session utility and allocation. It distributes computation more effectively across sessions, encouraging continued execution when it yields meaningful progress while suppressing low-utility computation. From this perspective, the central challenge is not how many sessions an agent should use, but how much useful progress it can derive from the sessions it executes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，有效的多会话优化伴随着会话效用和分配方面的改进。 它在不同会话间更有效地分配计算资源：当计算能带来有意义的进展时，会鼓励其持续执行；而当效用较低时，则会抑制此类计算。 从这个角度来看，核心挑战不在于智能体应该使用多少会话，而在于它能在所执行的会话中获得多少有用的进展。

paragraphs.en: Multi-session trajectories tend to arise naturally when agents tackle complex, long-horizon tasks. paragraphs.en: Context compaction and subagent forking both involve information transfer, but serve different purposes: compaction must preserve sufficient working state for continued execution; forking must provide the information needed to complete a subtask; merging must integrate subtask results into a state usable by the main agent. These operations motivate a shared research question: under a limited context budget, what information should be carried forward to support subsequent decisions? CompactionRL already jointly optimizes task execution and context summarization ( Li et al., 2026 ) . A unified approach to learning state transfer across compaction, forking, and merging remains an important direction, alongside systematic investigation of information loss and error accumulation over repeated transfers.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文压缩和子智能体分叉都涉及信息传递，但目的不同：压缩必须保留足够的运行状态以支持后续执行；分叉必须提供完成子任务所需的信息；合并则必须将子任务的结果整合成主智能体可用的状态。 这些操作引出了一个共同的研究问题：在上下文预算有限的情况下，哪些信息应当被保留下来以支持后续决策？ CompactionRL 已经联合优化了任务执行和上下文摘要（Li et al., 2026）。 在压缩、分叉和合并过程中学习状态传递的统一方法仍是一个重要方向，同时还需要系统研究重复传递过程中的信息丢失和错误累积问题。

paragraphs.en: For partial rollout or asynchronous training settings, multi-session execution can amplify variation in trajectory lengths and completion times, increase policy staleness and complicate within-group comparisons and sample reuse. For instance, prioritizing completed rollouts may favor trajectories with less sessions over longer ones associated with harder tasks, introducing selection bias and shaping learned execution strategies. Our experiments use a colocated setup with alternating rollout and training phases to minimize interference from asynchrony and isolate the effects of the optimization signals. Scaling toward actual production raises a further question: how can multi-session optimization remain reliable under asynchronous sampling and policy staleness? SAO explores asynchronous optimization with one rollout per prompt, using a learned value model ( Hou et al., 2026 ) . However, critic-free, group-relative optimization requires further investigation into when and how rollout groups are formed, how stale samples are handled, and how collected trajectories can be reused.
paragraphs.zh: 在部分展开或异步训练设置中，多会话执行可能会放大轨迹长度和完成时间的差异，增加策略过时问题，并使组内比较和样本重用变得更加复杂。 例如，优先选择已完成展开的轨迹可能会使较短会话的轨迹比与更难任务相关的较长轨迹更具优势，从而引入选择偏差并影响所学习的执行策略。 我们的实验采用共置设置，通过交替进行展开和训练阶段来最小化异步性带来的干扰，并单独分析优化信号的影响。 向实际生产环境扩展时，一个进一步的问题随之出现：在异步采样和策略过时的情况下，多会话优化如何保持可靠性？ SAO 探索了每次提示仅进行一次展开的异步优化方法，并使用了一个学习到的价值模型（Hou et al., 2026）。 然而，无需评论器且基于组相对优化的方法仍需进一步研究：何时以及如何组建展开组、如何处理过时样本，以及如何重用收集到的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: General multi-session agentic RL can accommodate workflows in which execution no longer follows a single, continuously accumulated context prefix. Context compaction and subagent forking, the two scenarios studied in this work, are representative examples of such workflows in modern agent harnesses. Progress in multi-session optimization could thus provide an important foundation for training agents within harnesses whose orchestration is partially opaque ( Xu et al., 2026a ) , such as Claude Code. Therefore, a critical next step is to systematically examine mechanisms across agent harnesses that disrupt context continuity, such as dropping reasoning tokens or tool responses, and improve general multi-session agentic RL under these conditions. Additionally, when discontinuity occurs, the choice between introducing a new session boundary and applying lossy concatenation with the preceding session may also influence the overall effectiveness of optimization.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we first identify a mismatch between the single-session assumption underlying most existing agentic RL methods and advanced agentic inference techniques such as context compaction and subagent forking. This motivates our formulation of Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning, which supports an arbitrary count of sessions within a trajectory. To address the coarse supervision issue existed in the currently widely used broadcasting approach, we further propose Mosaic , a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. By combining session-aware trajectory-level advantage estimation with session-level advantage shaping, Mosaic trains a Qwen3.5-4B agent that outperforms both single-session and multi-session baselines on BrowseComp. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of each component, while further analyses suggest that effective multi-session optimization might depend on improving session utility and allocation, a pattern observed in both broadcasting baseline and our Mosaic . We hope these findings will inform future research on multi-session agentic RL.

paragraphs.en: This section specifies the context compaction scenario used for the multi-session setting. The inference retains the standard ReAct interaction protocol, but converts a long execution into a sequence of sessions whenever the current working context can no longer safely accommodate another agent turn. All sessions are generated by the same policy. In the on-policy configuration used in our experiments, the compaction summary is also generated by the policy and is therefore optimized as a separate training segment.
paragraphs.zh: 本节说明了多会话设置中使用的上下文压缩场景。 推理过程保留了标准的 ReAct 交互协议，但每当当前工作上下文无法再安全地容纳另一个智能体轮次时，会将一次长执行转换为一系列会话。 所有会话均由同一策略生成。 在我们实验中使用的在线策略配置中，压缩摘要也由该策略生成，因此作为独立的训练部分进行优化。

paragraphs.en: This section specifies the subagent forking scenario used for the multi-session setting. Unlike context compaction, which rewrites the main agent’s context, subagent forking creates additional single-session search subagents that execute assigned subtasks and return their results to a persistent main-agent session.
